text:
incident-bot: PAGER: routing-fallback: elevated error rate and latency observed — multiple requests from eu-west are being routed to us-east fallback pool. Impact: higher p99 latency for premium tier and increased 5xxs. Pager: @sam (oncall) @maria (eng-sre) :rotating_light:

sam (oncall): on it. grabbing runbooks. any immediate customer reports?

oliver (cust-success): customer-reported slowdowns for two enterprise customers in EU, Metrica and FinOne. They see timeouts and degraded completions. They opened tickets.

maria (eng-sre): confirm: logs show spike in routing decisions to us-east at ~1886004260 with concurrent queue growth on us-east qpool-primed. hypothesis: regional capacity saturation triggered spillover policy.

lee (routing): checking routing policy weights and fallback chain now. Can everyone avoid changing model configs — I'm going to try weight dampening first.

anya (product): are premium customers configured to pin models? This looks like some premium traffic ended up on a quantized fallback model (q8_compat) — that would explain quality regressions.

sam (oncall): maria, can you dump the routing logs and the decision tree for a sample trace id? we need timeline and evidence for RCA.

maria (eng-sre): attaching clipped logs (sanitized) and trace ids. snippet below:

```
TRACE 1886004265 req=tx-8f3a model=rw-large-v1 region=eu-west decision=spillover->us-east fallback_model=rw-large-q8_compat route_score=0.42
WARN queue_depth us-east qpool-primed=98/100 p99_latency=1.6s
ERROR inference 5xx code=INFER_TIMEOUT backend=us-east-worker id=wk-7b2a
```

maria (eng-sre): full dump: https://internal.redwood/trace/1886004265 (internal only)

lee (routing): looking at policy: spillover_threshold set to 0.9 for eu-west. But what's weird is the decision engine applied fallback_model override for premium when all healthy variants existed. I'm seeing a config mismatch between the policy version deployed to eu-west edge and central config.

deploy-bot: config-deploy: routing-policy-v1.14 rolled to eu-west at 1886004200 by @lee (routing)

lee (routing): that deploy was a partial rollback to earlier policy to test dampening. Might have accidentally set fallback_preference to prefer lower-latency quantized variant when region mismatch occurred.

sam (oncall): @lee, can you revert that roll? If it's causing premium => q8 selection, that's a broken invariant.

lee (routing): initiating revert to routing-policy-v1.13 now. Command: `rpolicy rollback --env eu-west --to v1.13`

maria (eng-sre): while you revert, I'm increasing request-timeout for the us-east workers to reduce 5xxs (workaround). Running: `kubectl patch deployment us-east-infer --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"infer","env":[{"name":"REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS","value":"8000"}]}]}}}}'`

oliver (cust-success): informing Metrica and FinOne. telling them we're reverting routing policy and will follow up.

sam (oncall): timeline so far:
- 1886004200: routing-policy-v1.14 deployed to eu-west (partial)
- 1886004260: spillover observed, surge decisions to us-east
- 1886004265: first user complaints and increased 5xxs
- 1886004330: oncall page triggered
- 1886004380: revert started

maria (eng-sre): collected traces showing KV-cache misses spiking on us-east after surge — looks like cold caches increased latency further. snippet:

```
KV_CACHE miss_count=2048 -> 9872 within 20s window
LATENCY breakdown: serialization=120ms compute=420ms queue=760ms
```

anya (product): important for RCA: confirm whether premium traffic was actually pinned to specific model version or had soft-fallbacks allowed. If we allowed fallback overrides, that's product decision we need to review.

lee (routing): revert finished at 1886004520. After revert, routing decisions for incoming eu-west requests are back to eu-west primary pools and fallback preferences restored.

sam (oncall): monitoring post-revert. p95/p99 trending back down.

maria (eng-sre): metrics snapshot post-revert:
- p99 latency (premium eu-west) peaked 2.1s -> back to 420ms within 6m
- 5xx rate dropped from 6% -> 0.6%

oliver (cust-success): customers reporting improvement, one reopened ticket to ask for RCA and action items.

lee (routing): preliminary root cause candidates:
1) partial deploy of routing-policy-v1.14 introduced unintended fallback_preference change for eu-west, preferring q8 variant for cross-region failovers.
2) eu-west transient capacity drop (scheduled infra maintenance?) triggered spillover. need to correlate with infra events.
3) KV-cache cold start in us-east magnified latency and timeouts.

maria (eng-sre): adding infra events: there was a planned kernel update on eu-west-nodes group at 1886004180 — autoscaler lagged and node churn caused short capacity dip. I have the kube event logs.

sam (oncall): can we reproduce the decision logic locally? lee, capture the exact config diff between v1.13 and v1.14.

lee (routing): diff: fallback_preference: v1.13 = [primary_same_region, primary_compatible_model, cached_variant], v1.14 = [primary_same_region, lower_latency_variant, cached_variant] — that second entry is the problem for premium traffic. I'll attach patch.

maria (eng-sre): evidence matrix I'm going to build in-thread:
- Event correlation: node maintenance -> capacity dip (yes)
- Policy change: partial deploy v1.14 (yes)
- Model selection override: q8 fallback for premium (yes)
- Cache cold miss amplification: us-east cache misses spike (yes)
- Direct customer impact: confirmed via tickets (yes)

anya (product): action items for postmortem:
- revert policy change (done)
- enforce policy gating for premium tiers (prevent lower-quality fallback)
- improve deploy safety: require canary across regions not partial rollouts for routing rules
- reduce impact of cache cold-start: proactive pre-warming when spillover events detected

sam (oncall): immediate mitigation checklist completed: revert, timeout bump, CS notifications. Setting severity to Sev2 -> moving to RCA.

oliver (cust-success): I'll coordinate customer follow-ups and attach timeline + mitigation notes.

maria (eng-sre): next steps for RCA thread: please paste any additional traces or ticket ids here. I'll put together a timeline and include log excerpts, command history, and config diffs.

lee (routing): adding diff link: https://internal.redwood/configs/routing/v1.14/diff (internal)

sam (oncall): closing paging loop for now; oncall remains to support any regressions. last check at 1886007921 — system stable.

incident-bot: incident status: mitigated -> RCA in progress. Incident channel set to #postmortems when draft ready. :white_check_mark:
